annotations.text: Compact density pass — everything sized to fit one phone screen without scrolling. Config + all four test buttons + Start visible together. GitHub mark pinned 3px from the top-right corner.

Landscape / TV reflow (also what a tilted phone or tablet gets): a genuine two-column layout rather than a stretched phone view — configuration on the left, choose-a-test and Start on the right, so nothing scrolls off a wide screen. The blue tile shows the D-pad focus ring for TV remotes. First stab — tell me what to change.
